Kinds.dc.html.title: Every entity kind, on a phone too

n-speak.text: Before: two empty boxes and a dictionary that says 'No options yet'. After: who speaks, what is said, in which language and voice, each with the control made for it. 'Play a test now' really speaks and says so on the button; nothing plays by itself.

n-values.text: The rule the whole editor follows: the kind of value decides the control. A plain text box is the last resort, and a test fails if a colour, a time, a duration, an icon or an entity is ever drawn as one.
